acting_instructions: Speak in a soft, honeyed murmur with a perpetual sly grin, every word padded like paws on stone and every sibilant coiling like smoke. Keep the pace stealthy and measured with long, teasing pauses that suddenly snap into nimble, darting flurries—mischief and malice glinting beneath the sugar. Let the laugh be a velvet chuckle that never gets loud, a dagger wrapped in silk: charming, coaxing, and calmly predatory, never shouting. Finish many lines with a playful tail-flick of tone, letting phrases curl upward or taper into a secretive hush.
